name: page-founder
description: Founder section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7460:104311): a square photo with rounded corners beside an eyebrow, the heading (h2) with a small green second line inside it (e.g. the title), paragraphs and an icon link, on an indigo-50-to-white band with a soft green orb.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens), e.g. rex-kurzius.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

subtitle.description: Small green line drawn under the title inside the same h2, e.g. Founder and CEO.

body.description: Copy. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

link_label.description: Link under the copy. Renders only with link_url.

link_icon.description: Icon before the link: linkedin, or none.

image.description: Square photo (shown 450px, rounded). Empty = copy only.

image_width.description: Photo intrinsic width in px (0 omits it).
